summary: Add provider-neutral marking execution, safe fingerprint-only code storage, package aggregation, UPD/EDO state and reconciliation evidence.

impacts.evidence: All marking tables and reads use organization/workspace composite keys and FORCE RLS.
Raw codes are excluded from SQL, events, audit, SDK results and API; only fingerprints and expiring artifact references are durable.
Marking overview and scan endpoints are additive and expose safe bounded representations.
Lifecycle integration is constrained to existing envelope/outbox boundaries; no raw code payload is introduced.
Six new capabilities and typed marking operation ports are additive; old manifests remain valid.
Migration 37 is expand-only, high risk, backup-gated, checksummed and RLS protected.
RawCodeStore is callback-shaped, remote writes require approval/dry-run/idempotency and unknown outcomes are preserved.
All remote marking writes are write_sensitive; isolated signing and MChD remain host-owned.
Operations, scans, observations and drifts retain bounded metadata and append-only evidence.
Timeout is unknown, package graph is validated, scan idempotency is tenant-scoped and drift types are explicit.
Provider transports remain outside Core and require separate non-production qualification before admission.
Open operations, print work, drift counts and process stages are bounded operator signals.
Additive tables are backup-gated and provider writes remain fail-closed until qualification.
Domain/SDK tests and the RUNTIME-171 matrix cover duplicate, wrong, overflow, replay, unknown and worker recovery cases.
